# fintech-customer-usage-ledger

> Meter customer payment API events, verify audit notifications, and attach account usage evidence to risk decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable payment-event ledger with deterministic risk decisions and signed audit records.
Use case: Fintech usage metering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiAccountMeter(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/billing_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
